page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs using the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio, with no bundled local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance placing in the top 10% and Geekbench single-core scores in the top 25%. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core metrics, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached reads and writes also align with average tier performance. The processor supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16, alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

This instance offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe storage. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represents a tradeoff, prioritizing raw processing power over memory capacity. It is well-suited for single-threaded tasks, text processing, web serving, and general compute workloads that benefit from high-frequency AMD EPYC cores but do not demand local disk storage or GPU acceleration.
